messages:
jamie: Heads-up: supplier sent an amended manifest. Large tranche moved to late July; mini-tranche lands mid-June.
nora: Which reservation IDs and counts?
supply-bot: Manifest update: reservations [RC-11001, RC-11002] orig ETA 2026-06-12. New: RC-11001 -> 120 units (ETA 2026-06-20), RC-11002 -> 240 units (ETA 2026-07-26). Carrier note: "harbor congestion".
ryan: Which customers are on those reservations? Any hard SLA/launch dates?
jamie: Quick map: RC-11001 -> FinServe demo (120 GPUs, demo 2026-06-18). RC-11002 -> internal buffer + pilots.
leah: FinServe demo is public-facing. Missing it would be bad for the partnership announcement. Need contingency.
isha: Legal: do not promise credits in external comms. Phrase: "we're enacting mitigations and will pursue remedies under contract as needed."
ryan: Ops options: (A) ask supplier for airfreight (surcharge), (B) borrow from partner pool (mixed-SKU risk), (C) marketplace burst. Mixed-SKU needs fast compatibility tests.
nora: Any idle internal capacity we can reassign quickly?
jamie: We can free 50 GPUs from staging in ~12h and another 30 in 24h. That still leaves ~40 short for FinServe.
supply-bot: Supplier update: can early-release 80 units (mixed-SKU) if accepted; airfreight option for +120 units pending confirmation (needs PO by EOD).
ryan: Mixed-SKU acceptance requires validation (~4–6h). We can combine 80 early + 50 staging = 130, covers FinServe.
leah: If mixed-SKU, let's run a quick smoke test and inform FinServe. They may accept mixed hardware for the demo if we guarantee parity on demo workloads.
isha: Legal will prepare a short consent note for mixed-hardware and will review any customer message.
nora: Draft customer note: "We identified a supplier shipping change. We're activating mitigations to keep your demo on track; we'll follow up with details by EOD. No action needed." Legal ok?
isha: That phrasing is fine. Add one sentence that we may reassign resources and will provide a follow-up schedule.
jamie: Action list: @ryan confirm mixed-SKU validation plan and time, @jane (ops) free staging 50 GPUs, @supply-bot push supplier for written airfreight ETA and surcharge breakdown, @leah prep external note holding until we have confirmation.
ryan: Quick validation plan: smoke tests on mixed SKUs + driver verification -> 6h. Ops can do this overnight if we accept.
supply-bot: Supplier replied: 80-unit early release confirmed (mixed-SKU) ETA 2026-06-19. Airfreight for +120 units requires PO by EOD; surcharge estimate provided.
jamie: Given that, we'll accept early release and free staging GPUs. Hold off on airfreight PO until we see carrier terms; negotiate surcharge pass-through.
leah: I'll schedule the FinServe demo support and include a contingency run on mixed hardware. Also prepping a brief for the partner about potential mixed-hardware for the public demo.
ryan: Final inventory path: 80 early + 50 staging + 0 marketplace = 130 -> covers FinServe 120. Will run validation and share smoke report.
jamie: Closing loop for now. Keep manifests and BOLs attached to the ticket. Postmortem after July windows settle."
